count.guidance: Typically2~5 only when warranted; never meet a quota; one is valid

binding.evaluation_id: Server-assigned evaluation identity; never trust provider ID
binding.attempt_id: Immutable submitted attempt, resolved by server
binding.offset_unit: Unicode code points, zero-based, end exclusive, no normalization

item_fields.quote: Exact complete sentence copied from this submitted answer only
item_fields.diagnosis: Friendly Korean explanation, no preference presented as an error
item_fields.example: Optional minimal rewrite, omit if unnecessary; never decide a new stance

rules: Do not invent errors or quote other students/reference answers.
Preserve original argument, stance and voice. Do not rewrite all sentences.
Prioritize logical contradiction, unclear meaning, important grammar/agreement, then expression.
Deduplicate the same root issue across sentence feedback and improvements; reference one issue identity rather than repeating criticism.
No issue: empty array. Uncertain reading: omit quote-dependent finding, preserve uncertainty separately.
No permanent student weakness classification; longitudinal grouping is versioned observational analysis.
validation: Before persistence resolve attempt from evaluation; verify answer hash and exact code-point slice equals quote.
Reject unknown category/priority, blank quote/diagnosis/direction, invalid offsets, duplicate root issue/span, more than5.
Source existence alone does not prove diagnosis is true or rewrite preserves stance; independent quality/owner review remains required.
Provider quote never becomes trusted through UI display; server validation is mandatory.
storage_status: Existing history/FKs reusable; structured category/span/example persistence missing; no migration or production RPC changes in this task.
